spots.title: Find a spot
spots.how1: Screening on a 500 m grid: RGE ALTI 100 m terrain, Filosofi population (200 m cells), terrain screening at 63 Hz under propagation-favourable conditions.
spots.how2: Flat sites are ranked by the number of residents exposed above the threshold.
spots.ledeMap: Around the map centre, ranked by residents exposed to the bass.
spots.ledeSono: Around the placed sound system, ranked by residents exposed to the bass.
spots.radiusHint: Search distance. 30 km covers 2,800 km²; larger is slower.
spots.levelHint1: Continuous level of the whole system in the bass, in dB(C), referred to 1 m in free field: what the rig actually puts out.
spots.levelHint2: This is not sensitivity. Sensitivity (dB at 1 W / 1 m) only tells a speaker's efficiency, not the level it reaches with its amplifier.
spots.levelHint3: Reference: 1 × 18" sub ≈ 119 · 2 subs ≈ 125 · 4 subs ≈ 131 · 8 subs ≈ 137 (+6 dB per doubling).
spots.thresholdHint1: Outdoor level at the dwellings above which a resident counts as “exposed”.
spots.thresholdHint2: Lower is safer: bass travels far and goes through walls. At 50 dB(C) outside, the bass is still audible indoors at night.
spots.reportSite: {{checked}} checked on site: {{wooded}} wooded, {{noAccess}} without access
spots.none: No spot meets the criteria. Widen the radius or relax the site criteria.
spots.clickHint: Click a spot to put the sound system there and open the parcel card.

site.clearingHint: Radius of the tree-free disc required around the system: 50 m ≈ 0.8 ha, 100 m ≈ 3.1 ha. Checked every 25 m.
site.accessMaxHint: Maximum straight-line distance between the system and the nearest allowed road.
site.shiftHint: Screening uses a 500 m grid: each spot may move up to this distance to find suitable ground.
site.waysHint: BD TOPO road sections. Footpaths, steps and ways “physically impossible” by car are always excluded. At equal distance, a road beats a gravel road, which beats a track.
site.vegetation: The clearing must be free of
site.vegetationHint1: Not known in advance: during the search, BD TOPO (IGN) vegetation is downloaded around each candidate and the clearing is checked point by point.
site.vegetationHint2: Woods and closed forests are always excluded: that is what a clearing means. Other types can be set here.
site.forestAlways: Woods and closed forests: always excluded.

level.title: How do I know this level?
level.measureHint1: Sound level meter (or a calibrated phone app), C-weighting, slow time or a one-minute Leq.
level.measureHint2: Music at party level, open ground, facing the system and at least 20 m away (closer, you only measure one cabinet).
level.measureHint3: Formula: reading + 20·lg(distance) − 3 dB (the ground, which the screening adds itself).
level.sheetHint1: Sensitivity (1 W / 1 m): a sub's efficiency. On its own it does not give the level; add the power: sensitivity + 10·lg(power).
level.sheetHint2: Power: continuous (RMS or AES) per sub, not “peak” or “program”.
level.sheetHint3: Half-space: most sub datasheets measure on the ground; subtract 6 dB.
level.sheetHint4: Stacked subs: in the bass they add in phase, +6 dB per doubling (2 subs: +6, 4 subs: +12).
level.sheetHint5: We also subtract 3 dB of power compression at full power. If the datasheet gives a “continuous max SPL”, use it instead of sensitivity + power.

bf.title: Low frequencies (GFPE)
bf.lede: Parabolic equation over 360 azimuths, third-octaves 25–200 Hz, LiDAR terrain, ground per segment, AROME weather profile (Monin-Obukhov) and 3 reference scenarios. Merged with the engineering method above 200 Hz.
bf.stale: The system has changed since: run again.
bf.uncertainty: Shown uncertainty: the “median” and “P90” maps in the Map tab bracket the scenarios. Expected accuracy: ±3 dB within 500 m, ±5 to 10 dB several km away at night.

dim.title: Inverse sizing
dim.needDf: Draw the dance floor first (Rig tab).

opt.title: Optimiser
opt.lede: Position (±60 m), azimuth (15° steps) and sub arrangement (as is, cardioid, end-fire): maximises the margin at the most exposed building while keeping the dance-floor level.
opt.gfpe: GFPE check: max emergence {{em}} dB(A) · margin {{margin}} dB
opt.method: Coarse search with the engineering method, then a GFPE check (forecast scenario) of the best 3.

project.title: Project
project.autosave: The project is also saved automatically in the zone folder.

ground.title: Ground: geology and state
ground.lede: Cliffs (slope ≥ 45°) treated as rock. BRGM geology (1:1,000,000 lithology): thin soils on hard rock are hardened. Ground state at the computation hour (Open-Meteo): moisture hardens the ground, snow makes it very absorbent.
ground.relief: Terrain: {{kind}} (position {{tpi}} m relative to surroundings, regional slope {{slope}}° towards {{toward}}°)
ground.coldPool: “cold-air pool + katabatic wind” scenario added to the low-frequency computation.
ground.noState: Ground state not downloaded for this date.

veg.title: LiDAR HD vegetation
veg.lede: Downloads COPC point clouds around the system (≈ 2 m level of detail, about 40 MB per km²): foliage density in 5 m × 2 m voxels and ground roughness. Measured foliage replaces the ISO 9613-2 “dense foliage” lump value.
veg.summary: {{tiles}} tiles, {{mpts}} M points within {{km}} km — dense foliage {{dense}} km² (mean factor {{factor}}), mean roughness {{rough}} cm.
veg.none: Not downloaded yet: ISO lump value (CHM ≥ 3 m = dense foliage).

calib.title: Calibration on measurements
calib.lede: CSV (columns lat, lon, LAeq and/or LCeq) or sound-level-meter GPX. Fits ground hardness, sound-speed gradient (stability, wind) and a level offset on the engineering method.
calib.active: Active calibration: ground σ × {{sigma}}, gradient {{gt}} + {{gw}} s⁻¹ (wind), {{offset}} dB — residual error {{rms}} dB over {{n}} points.
